title: sida corrugata var. filiformis
intro: Sida corrugata var. filiformis, commonly known as the filiform sida, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida corrugata var. filiformis include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
